{{Quote|All I can see to do now is try to make sure Nil Spaar stays on his side of the moat. Protect the settlements that haven't been torched-Galantos, Wehttam, The Marais.|[[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] to [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="Before the Storm">''[[Before the Storm]]''</ref>}}
'''The Marais''' were a group of [[Planet/Legends|planets]] in the [[Hatawa sector/Legends|Hatawa sector]] in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] that petitioned the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] for membership after the [[Yevethan Purge]] began.
